faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All editing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: Does it validate JSON while I edit?
faq.answer: Yes. The editor provides live syntax validation and highlights errors as you type.

faq.question: Can I format JSON in the editor?
faq.answer: Yes. You can format and beautify your JSON with proper indentation at any time.

faq.question: Can I edit large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

faq.question: What is the difference between JSON editor and JSON formatter?
faq.answer: A JSON editor lets you modify JSON data interactively. A JSON formatter only restructures existing JSON with proper indentation.

faq.question: Is this a free online JSON editor?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online json editor where you can json edit online with syntax highlighting and validation. No sign-up or upload required — edit json directly in your browser.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有编辑在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。

faq.question: 编辑时会验证 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 会。编辑器提供实时语法验证，输入时会高亮显示错误。

faq.question: 可以在编辑器中格式化 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以随时格式化和美化 JSON，添加正确的缩进。

faq.question: 可以编辑大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。

faq.question: JSON 编辑器和 JSON 格式化有什么区别？
faq.answer: JSON 编辑器让你交互式地修改 JSON 数据。JSON 格式化只是用正确的缩进重新排列现有的 JSON。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的在线json编辑器吗？
